text:
Jules: heads up — found a scoping bug where dashboard preview widgets briefly show cards from other org when using quick-preview. repro below.
Ken: can you drop the repro steps and which env?
Jules: repro: 1) user in org-X with access to org-Y 2) open dashboard list -> hover preview on dashboard A 3) while preview inflates, switch org via quick-switch -> preview flashes rows from org-Y then corrects. seen in chrome network.
Rina: which API endpoint is used by the preview?
Jules: `/api/internal/preview/dashboard?id=...&user=...` the response includes `cards: [...]` and `owner_org`. sometimes owner_org != requested org.
Ken: happened after the latest prefetch pooling change? we prefetched previews into a shared pool to reduce latency.
Jules: yes. this popped up after prefetch pooling. seems like pool workers reuse last-owner metadata.
ops-bot: checking runtime metrics for preview service between 4391234500-4391234700... 7 preview requests had mismatched owner_org tag. link: https://internal/logs/4391234567-preview-mismatch
Pablo: quick check: do we namespace internal cache or worker state by org? if not, that's likely it.
Rina: looked at preview worker code — `last_preview_meta` stored on worker instance and used as fast-path if request is small. missing explicit owner_org check. oops.
Ken: workaround: make fast-path validate owner_org == request.org and fallback to cold fetch. low-risk patch. we should also avoid storing org-scoped mutable state on long-lived workers.
Jules: agree. plan: 1) push validation guard in preview worker (hotfix) 2) add unit + integration test for multi-org users 3) audit other pooled services for similar `last_*` state.
Pablo: add telemetry: `preview.owner_mismatch` counter + sample logging with request id. will help detect other occurrences.
ops-bot: created alert `preview-owner-mismatch > 1/min` and sent to #eng-oncall.
Ken: I'll author the hotfix PR, target patch window in 20m. include cache/worker state cleanup in PR.
Rina: adding integration test to repro on CI with a synthetic multi-org user. also will add code comment about not caching org-identity in worker-local fields.
Jules: FYI product — this can cause users to briefly see cards from other orgs; low window but likely confusing. recommend we add a short note to rollout checklist: test pooled workers under multi-tenant context switching.
Pablo: created follow-up ticket RT-1166 to audit pooled workers for tenant-agnostic state.
Ken: deploying hotfix to canary. ops-bot: kick canary?
ops-bot: canary deploy initiated at 4391234590. health ok for 2/3.
Jules: monitoring preview.owner_mismatch metric — zero in canary window so far.
Pablo: after canary, we'll invalidate worker-local caches across instances to flush any stale meta.
Rina: PR: https://phabricator/PR/7944 — adds owner check, tests.
Ken: rolled to prod at 4391234620, no alerts. closing once RT-1166 is scheduled.
Jules: thanks team. leaving note: consider making preview fast-path pure (no mutable global state) next quarter. :memo:
Pablo: RT-1166 scheduled for next sprint. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
